status: MEASURED — first head-to-head; white-box vs steelmanned black-box on the SAME open model
design_note: same-model comparison isolates activation access with capability held fixed; black-box arm is the honest proxy for the best a CLOSED model of this capability could do

surface_features_degloss.reading: if ~= white_box, the signal is STYLE not truth (the gloss trap)

shuffle_label_leakage.reading: must be ~0.5; validates the grouped-CV pipeline

controls.split: GroupKFold by question — the right/hallucinated PAIR is never split across train/test

gates.VERDICT: INVALID (dataset defect) — the subset is STYLE-SEPARABLE (surface-only AUROC 0.9812), so both arms saturate and the wedge is UNMEASURABLE here. This is NOT evidence that the white-box wedge is absent; it is evidence this benchmark subset cannot test it. G-H2 (not-gloss) is the failing gate; G-H1's failure is downstream of the ceiling effect it causes.

honest_scope.power: 40 questions / 80 answers is THIN; fold SDs reported; a full HaluEval QA run (10k) is the confirming step
honest_scope.no_closed_model_run: no closed frontier model was called (would be real spend + confounds capability); the black-box arm is the signal-class proxy, stated as such
honest_scope.scale: 1.5B is CONSERVATIVE for the probe — the measured ladder showed white-box detectability RISES with scale (assoc 0.70->0.92), so an open frontier model should widen this wedge, not narrow it

corrected_diagnosis.primary_finding: HaluEval QA pairs (this 40-question subset) are separable by surface style alone at AUROC 0.9812
corrected_diagnosis.consequence: any probe/black-box AUROC reported on such a set is confounded with style; our own 0.9987 included
corrected_diagnosis.what_this_does_NOT_show: it does NOT show white-box has no advantage — the ceiling effect precludes measuring one either way
corrected_diagnosis.what_it_DOES_show: the de-gloss control is NECESSARY methodology for honesty evals; without it a 0.99 AUROC means nothing. Second independent occurrence of the gloss trap this program (first: 0.5B glossed 1.000 vs de-glossed ~chance).
corrected_diagnosis.the_valid_rerun: repeat on the de-glossed v1.10 probe set (data/eval/v1_10/probe-sets-v1.jsonl, 294 rows, built style-matched) where surface-only should sit near chance
